import dataclasses,json,time
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.cli import slug
from makemarket.evaluate import run_player
from makemarket.games import make_game
from makemarket.llm import ChatClient,LLMConfig,LLMQuoter,Throttle,parse_quote
from makemarket.market import Observation
from makemarket.prompts import messages_for
from makemarket.provenance import receipt,file_sha256

root=Path('results/expansion')
path=root/'protocol-gemma4.json'
assert not path.exists(), 'Inspect existing receipt and caches before resuming'
label='google/gemma-4-31b-it (no-think)'
cfg=LLMConfig(model='google/gemma-4-31b-it',label=label,timeout=600,max_tokens=4096,temperature=0.3,
              extra_body={'chat_template_kwargs':{'enable_thinking':False}})
provenance={**receipt({'purpose':'availability-selected optional Gemma API baseline; outcomes remain sealed'},'NIM immutable deployment revision not exposed'),
            'config':dataclasses.asdict(cfg),'source_sha256':file_sha256(Path(__file__)),
            'plan_sha256':file_sha256(root/'gemma4_plan.json')}
entry={'model':cfg.model,'label':label,'max_tokens':cfg.max_tokens,'temperature':cfg.temperature,
       'extra_body':cfg.extra_body,'timeout_seconds':cfg.timeout,'provenance':provenance,'source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
def save():path.write_text(json.dumps({label:entry},indent=2)+'\n')
client=ChatClient(cfg,cache_dir='cache/expansion',throttle=Throttle(1),max_retries=3)
game=make_game('dice');episode=game.episode(80000)
obs=Observation(game,2,6,episode.reveals[:3],[],0,0.0,episode.public_beliefs[2],episode.public_beliefs[2].mean)
started=time.monotonic()
try:
 entry['probe']=client.chat(messages_for(obs));parse_quote(entry['probe']['content'],game.params.max_size)
 entry['usable']=True
except Exception as exc:entry.update(usable=False,error=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')
entry['probe_wall_seconds']=time.monotonic()-started;save()
print('Gemma availability:',entry['usable'],flush=True)
if entry['usable']:
 for name in ['dice','cards']:
  started=time.monotonic();out=root/'raw'/name/f'{slug(label)}.jsonl';error=None
  try:
   for seed in range(200,400):
    if datetime.now(timezone.utc)>=datetime(2026,11,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc):
     error='Registered optional acquisition UTC cutoff';break
    run_player(make_game(name),lambda:LLMQuoter(client),[seed],out,workers=1,provenance=provenance)
    if (seed-199)%5==0:print(name,seed-199,'episodes',round(time.monotonic()-started),'seconds',flush=True)
  except Exception as exc:error=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'
  count=len(out.read_text().splitlines()) if out.exists() else 0
  entry[name]={'episodes':count,'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'error':error};save()
print('Gemma optional batch finished; complete cohorts await frozen selections.',flush=True)
selection: Availability and parse validity on fixed validation seed 80000 round 2 only; no PnL-based inclusion. Every complete cohort eligible; incomplete cohorts unscored.
cutoff: Stop starting new optional episodes at primary 27B test acquisition completion or 2026-11-01T00:00Z, whichever is earlier. The UTC cutoff is checked before each episode; parent agent enforces earlier acquisition completion.
